about: Gregory the Wonder-worker, asked by the chief bishops how long Rome's curb for the enemy (the bridle made from the nails) and Ethiopia's chariot (Zion) will remain, foretells that a Roman king will pervert the faith, lose the bridle in the sea, and that Ethiopia will keep the right faith to the end (ch. 113). Zion will come at the last day, the dead will rise, and Enoch, Elijah, Moses and Aaron will open the Ark and shame the Jews with the tablets, the manna and Aaron's rod (ch. 114). Christ and the twelve apostles reproach Israel, the faithful are spared, and the sinners are judged by measure (ch. 115). Dillmann was not open for this draft; uncertain readings are marked (?). Source slips are kept as printed and noted: ጳጵሳት, ውስ ተ, ባውስተ, ሃሬኔዎስ/መርቅያኖስ, ቦዘያሜክርዎ, ፼ ዓመት.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፲፫ is 113. በእንተ 'concerning' governs ሰረገላ 'chariot' and ወመግረሬ 'and the restrainer of' (?), with ፀር 'enemy' in the genitive. I cannot place መግረሬ without Dillmann (unavailable); the chapter itself shows it is the bit made from the nails of the cross, so 'curb, bit' (?) for the enemy. The chariot is Zion, on which the Ethiopian king 'runs' (unit 14).

sentences.i: The chief bishops answered and said to Gregory, the worker of wonders, 'Behold, we have asked, and you have given us to understand that the kings of Ethiopia are honoured and great on account of Zion;
sentences.n: Speakers: ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት 'chiefs of bishops' (construct plural), the bishops gathered in council, who address Gregory (ጎርጎርዮስ), here called ገባሬ መንክር 'worker of wonder', the Wonder-worker. The verbs: አውሥኡ 'they answered' (causative of ወሥአ); ወይቤልዎ 'and they said to him' (ብህለ + -ልዎ); ጠየቅነ 'we asked' (ጠየቀ, 1st plural perfect); ወአለበውከነ: አለበወ 'give understanding' (causative of ለበወ) with -ከ, the 2nd masc. singular ending of the perfect ('you gave understanding'), + -ነ '1st plural us' as the object. ከብሩ and ዐብዩ are perfect 3rd plural of ከበረ 'be honoured' and ዐበየ 'be great', with the subject ነገሥተ 'kings' after the verbs. The ከመ clause gives what they have learned. Zion (the Ark) is the ground of Ethiopia's greatness.

sentences.i: and again, that the kings of Rome are great on account of the nails from which Helena made a bridle; and it became for the king of Rome a curb for the enemy, and for the king of Ethiopia it became a chariot, and he too overcame his enemy;
sentences.n: The Roman side: ቅንዋት 'nails' (the nails of the cross; house rendering), from which ዘገብረት 'which she made' (ዘ- + perfect 3rd feminine, the subject Helena, እሌኒ, mother of Constantine, who in tradition found the cross) a ልጓም 'bridle' (ልጓመ is accusative). ኮኖ 'it became to him' (ኮነ + -ኦ) is anticipatory: the -ኦ is picked up by ለንጉሠ ሮም and again by ለንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ. So the same pair of objects serves both kings: the nails/bridle for Rome, Zion as chariot for Ethiopia. ወውእቱኒ ሞአ ፀሮ 'and he too overcame his enemy': ሞአ 'overcame' (G perfect); 'he' is most naturally the Ethiopian king, the last named (?).

sentences.i: Tell us, for God has revealed to you what was and what will be, in vision and in prophecy, as to Moses and Elijah.'
sentences.n: ከሠተ 'revealed' (G perfect), with ለከ 'to you'; ዘኮነ ወዘይከውን 'that which was and that which will be', the two ዘ- clauses both the object. ራእየ ወትንቢተ are accusatives of manner, 'as vision and prophecy'. Moses and Elijah are the two who spoke with God and were seen with Christ on the mountain (Matthew 17:3); they stand for the prophet who is shown things. The bishops' speech ends at the ።.

sentences.i: He answered and said to them, 'I will explain to you about the king of Rome: when he transgresses and provokes God within this faith that we ordained as the faith, there is one who will transgress it, the king who is to come in Rome; and one chief bishop will join with him, and they will change it and thrust aside the word of the twelve apostles, and will shift it into the desire of their hearts, and will teach by their own will, and will turn the Book to their own freedom (?);
sentences.n: Gregory replies. The perfects after ሶበ (ተዐደወ, ወአምዐዖ) are read as prophetic, 'when he transgresses', since the whole speech looks ahead. ተዐደወ 'transgresses' (ዐደወ 'pass over'), ወአምዐዖ 'and provokes him' (አምዐ, the house lemma for 'provoke to anger', stem uncertain as in አምዕዕዎ ch. 2–8, + -ኦ, doubled by ለእግዚኣብሔር). ባውስተ is printed so; read as በውስተ 'within, in' (?), a spelling slip. ሀሎ + imperfect (ይትዐደዋ) = 'is to', 'is about to': the 'faith' is feminine, hence -ዋ 'it/her' on ይትዐደዋ, ይዌልጥዋ, ይገፈትእዋ. ዘይመጽእ ንጉሥ 'a king who comes', not named here. ጳጵሳት is printed for ጳጳሳት, a source slip, kept. ይዌልጥዋ 'they will change' (ወለጠ), ይገፈትእዋ 'thrust aside' (ገፍትአ 'push, thrust'). ለነገረ marks the object: 'the word of the twelve apostles'. ወያፈልስዎ 'and they will move it' (causative of ፈለሰ 'migrate'; -ዎ is masculine, so it is the 'word' ነገር, not the feminine faith), ውስተ ፍትወተ ልቦሙ 'into the desire of their hearts'. The last clause has a source slip: ውስ ፡ ተ is printed as two words; it must be ውስተ 'into'. ግዕዞሙ is ግዕዝ 'freedom, liberty' (the word that names the Geʿez language) + -ሙ 'their', so 'to their own freedom' (?), i.e. as they please, or perhaps 'into their own tongue' (?); I cannot be sure of the sense without Dillmann (?). The unit has 43 words and no ፤ to cut at, so it is kept whole.

sentences.i: As an apostle said, because they themselves have set up their own heads like Sodom and Gomorrah (?);
sentences.n: An apostle is cited without a name; Sodom and Gomorrah are the standing example in 2 Peter 2:6 and Jude 7, but the words here are not a quotation I can match to either, so the saying is given as printed. አትከሉ 'they planted, set up' (ተከለ 'plant, fix'; the causative-looking አ- is as printed) with ርእሶሙ 'their heads' as object: 'set up their own heads' = made themselves the head (?). አትከሉ may instead mean 'made firm, stiffened' (cf. ተከለ 'fix'), 'stiffened their heads' (?). በዘ ለሊሆሙ 'in that they themselves' (ለሊሆሙ is the emphatic 'themselves'). The sense of the comparison is uncertain (?).

sentences.n: Matthew 7:15, 'wolves in sheep's clothing', put as a saying to the disciples. ተዐቅቡ 'guard yourselves' (imperative of ተዐቀበ), እምእለ 'from those who'. በአልባሰ አባግዕ 'in garments of sheep' (construct of plural አልባስ; አባግዕ plural of በግዕ). ወእንተ ውስጦሙሰ is odd: እንተ is the feminine relative and would not agree with 'wolves'; I take it as 'and what is within them' = 'while within them', as in the Gospel (?). ተኵላት 'wolves'. ወመሠጥ is read as 'and ravening (?)', መሠጠ 'snatch' (as in ch. 60a), echoing 'ravening wolves'; unsure without Dillmann (?).

sentences.i: And when they have perverted the faith, the curb for the enemy will be taken away from them, and the throne of Peter too will have none to sit upon it among those who changed our faith;
sentences.n: The consequence. አዕለውዋ 'they perverted her' (causative of ዐለወ, 'twist, pervert'; -ዋ is the faith); ትትሀየድ is the tä- passive of ሀየደ 'remove, take away', the subject መግረሬ ፀር treated as feminine. መንበረ ጴጥሮስ 'throne of Peter' (construct) is the see of Rome; -ኒ 'too'. አልቦ ዘይነብር ዲቤሃ 'there is no one who sits on her', and the apposition እለ ወለጡ ሃይማኖትነ ('those who changed our faith') says who is excluded. For ዲቤሃ, ዲበ (stem ዲቤ-) + -ሃ 'upon her'. The Roman see will lose its legitimacy for the heretical, with the 'curb' gone.

sentences.i: for the angel of God who guards the throne of Peter in Rome will be commanded (?), and God will remove the curb for the enemy from him, from the king who does not keep the faith; the Persians will fight him, and his name, it seems to me, is Marcian, a perverter of the faith;
sentences.n: ይትኤዝዝ is the tä- stem of አዘዘ 'command', 'will be commanded'; but ተአዘዘ means 'obey' in ch. 112, so 'will obey' is possible (?); what the angel is told is not stated (to withdraw?). ዘየዐቅባ 'who guards her' (ዐቀበ 'keep, guard'). የሀይዳ 'he will remove' (ሀየደ). ዘኢየዐቅብ 'who does not keep'. ይፀብእዎ 'they will fight him' (ፀብአ). The king is called መርቅያኖስ with the author's own hedge ይመስለኒ 'it seems to me' (the author speaks in the first person). Marcian, the emperor of the council of Chalcedon (450-457), is the likeliest reference, but history does not fit the Persian war that follows; I keep the name as printed. ዕልወ is read as 'perverter' or 'perverse (in)' (ዕልው), a construct before ሃይማኖት (?).

sentences.i: As for the nails, they will shine there in the sea until Christ comes again in great glory on the cloud of heaven with power. This God showed me in the pit;
sentences.n: ቅንዋት 'nails', and ታበርህ 'she shines' (3rd feminine singular imperfect of አብርሀ, causative of በርሀ 'be bright'): the plural is treated as a collective feminine. The Second Coming is in the words of Matthew 24:30 (the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory); ዳግመ 'again' is the accusative adverb. ዘንተኬ 'this indeed' is the object of አርአየኒ 'he showed me' (አርአየ, causative of ርእየ, with -ኒ). በውስተ ግብ 'in the pit': the author gives Gregory a vision in a pit, in the manner of Gregory the Illuminator of Armenia, who was imprisoned in one, though the text says only 'Gregory'. The seer is the speaker.

sentences.i: She will abide in the right faith until the coming of our Lord, and there is nothing she holds fast to (?) beyond the word of the apostles; and as for us, as we have ordained, she will remain (?) until the end of the world.
sentences.n: The subject ትነብር 'she will dwell' is feminine and unnamed, probably Ethiopia, the land of the king and Zion (?). ትጸንን is the problem: if from ጸንዐ 'be firm', the final -ን is a slip, and I give 'holds fast'; the sense might be 'strays' (?). እምቃለ 'beyond, apart from the word of' (እም- comparative). ወንሕነ በከመ ሠራዕነ 'and we, as we have ordained' resumes unit 5. ትሄሉ is 3rd fem. singular and does not agree with 'we'; a plural ending may have been lost (?). እስከ ኅልቀተ ዓለም 'until the end of the world' (Matthew 28:20). The single ፨ here ends a stretch of Gregory's speech and the unit; the run of ፨ comes at the end of the chapter.

sentences.n: Antichrist asked about. ሰማልያል (printed so) is the name given to the false Messiah ('Antichrist'); the form looks like Samael with -yal (?), an unknown to me. ዘውእቱ ሐሳዌ መሲሕ 'who is the false messiah' (ሐሳዌ 'liar, false'). አመኬ 'when then' (or 'if then', እመኬ (?)). ይትኀበልኑ 'will it be harmed' (ተኀበለ 'be injured, damaged'; -ኑ marks the question). ውሕኮ is a crux: read as 'weakening, being few' (ውሕክ 'few') (?), so 'be harmed, diminished' (?). ሃይማኖቶሙ ለኢትዮጵያ 'their faith, of Ethiopia' (collective 'their' for the country). sentences.n: Gregory's closing comment on the psalm. ዘንተ ዘይቤ 'this which he said' stands before the main clause as a topic (David's words); ኢየዐልዉ 'they will not pervert' and ኢይዌልጡ 'they will not change' are 3rd plural, the subject the people of Ethiopia and their enemies, left open. ወሥርዐትነ 'and our ordinance' (ሥርዓት). ወዘእለ እምቅድሜነ 'and that of those before us', then the apposition መምህራነ ሕግ ሐዋርያት 'teachers of the law, the apostles'. sentences.n: ወታስተርኢ 'and she will appear' (አስተርአየ). ድሉተ 'ready' (accusative predicate, fem.). ወሕንጽታ 'and her building' (ሕንጽት 'building' + -ኣ '3fs her' (?); cf. ሕንጽት in ch. 9–12); I take it as her construction, the Ark's make. ቀፈላ 'he shut her' (ቀፈለ 'close, fasten'; Dillmann not at hand (?)), with -ኣ 'her' (ቀፈለ + ኣ, written ላ; the Ark); ቀፈለ is 'cover, enclose' in ch. 17–20, so 'shut' is a guess (?). በ፫ ማኅተም 'with three seals': the three seals are not identified in the text.

sentences.i: As he said in the law of the old and of the new, 'By the testimony of two or three let every matter stand.' And then Isaiah the prophet said, 'The dead will rise and live, those in the tomb, for the dew that comes from you is their life.'
sentences.n: Two quotations. First, the rule of witnesses, Deuteronomy 19:15, repeated in Matthew 18:16 and 2 Corinthians 13:1; ዘብሉይ ወዘሐዲስ 'of the old and of the new' means both testaments. The text has ፪ ወ፫ 'two and three'; ይቁም is the jussive of ቆመ. Second, Isaiah 26:19. ጠል 'dew' as the life-giving dew of the resurrection; ዘእምኀቤከ 'which is from you' (God). The dew of mercy returns in the next unit. ወአሜሃ 'and then' marks the second proof.

sentences.n: The four who testify: Enoch and Elijah, who never died (Genesis 5:24, 2 Kings 2:11), come እንዘ ሕያዋን 'while living'; Moses and Aaron, who did, are raised (ሐይዉ 'they lived', perfect). ምስለ ኵሉ 'with all' = with everyone else. መዛግሒሃ 'her bolts' (?): I take the word from a root 'shut', 'fasten' (ዘገሐ) (?), since the Ark is opened and its contents are shown in the next unit; 'her treasuries' (መዛግብት) would be a stretch. ይፈትሑ 'they will open, loosen' (ፈትሐ). ወያርእይዎሙ 'and they will show them' (አርአየ), ለአይሁድ ሰቃልያን 'to the Jews, crucifiers' (ሰቃልያን, plural of an agent noun from ሰቀለ). ወይወቅሥዎሙ ወይዛለፍዎሙ 'they will rebuke them and reproach them' (ወቀሠ, ዘለፈ). ዘዐለዉ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'what they perverted, the word of God' (ዐለወ, as unit 8).

sentences.i: And they will see what he wrote for them with his hand, the words of his commandment; and the manna, how he fed them without toil, with its measure, the gomor; and spiritual Zion, who came down for their salvation; and the rod of Aaron, which budded, in the likeness of Mary.
sentences.n: What the opened Ark holds, as in Hebrews 9:4: the tablets (Exodus 31:18, 'written with the finger of God'; here 'by his hand'), the manna with its omer (Exodus 16:32-33), and Aaron's rod that budded (Numbers 17:8). ቃላተ ለትእዛዙ 'words of his commandment', i.e. the Ten Words. ሴሰዮሙ 'he fed them' (ሴሰየ); ዘእንበለ ጻማ 'without toil'. ጎሞር is a loan from Hebrew omer, a measure. መንፈሳዊት ጽዮን 'spiritual Zion', ዘወረደት 'who came down' (ወረደ), for their salvation (ለመድኀኒቶሙ), joins the Ark with the heavenly Zion. ወበትረ አሮንመ 'and the rod of Aaron, indeed' (-መ is read as a particle like -ሰ here (?)). ሠረጸት 'she sprouted'. The rod is read as a type of Mary, as with Jacob's staff in chapter 112. The ፨ run closes chapter 114.

sentences.i: And he will answer them and say to them, 'Why did you deny me, and turn perversely against me, and crucify me, after all this that I did for you? I saved you, and gave you my help (?), from Satan and from the bondage of Pharaoh, and I came for your sake. And you, see how you nailed me and pierced me.' And the twelve apostles will rise and judge them, saying to them, 'We made you hear, and you did not hear, the prophecy of the prophets and our preaching, we the apostles.'
sentences.n: Christ speaks to the Jews at the last day. ወያወሥኦሙ 'and he will answer them', the verb in the imperfect. ክሕድክሙኒ 'you denied me' (ክሕደ), ወዐለውክሙኒ 'you acted perversely to me' (ዐለወ, here with a person as object (?)), ወሰቀልክሙኒ 'you hung me' = crucified, each with -ኒ 'me'. ዘንተ ኵሎ ዘገበርኩ ለክሙ 'this all, which I did for you', set before the verbs as a reproach. ወሪድየ is a crux (?): the form looks like a noun for 'help' + -የ 'my' (from ረድአ; cf. ረድኤት), 'and my help (?)', or an unclear verb; I render 'and gave you my help (?)'. Both እም- phrases, 'from Satan' and 'from the bondage of Pharaoh' (ግብርና 'bondage', ወእምግብርናተ), depend on the saving. ወበእንቲአክሙኒ 'and for your sake'. ርእዩ 'see!' (imperative). ቀነውክሙኒ 'you nailed me' (house: nail), ወረገዝክሙኒ 'you pierced me' (?), as in John 19:34. ፲ወ፪ ሐዋርያት 'the twelve apostles' will judge (Matthew 19:28; Luke 22:30). አስማዕናክሙ 'we made you hear' (causative of ሰምዐ). ለነ ለሐዋርያት 'ours, of the apostles', the repeated appositive.

sentences.n: The Devil is 'their father' as in John 8:44. ዘአመከሮሙ 'who tempted them' (አመከረ, as ያሜክርዎ in unit 31). መስሕታን 'deceivers' (plural of መስሕት), in apposition to demons. ይትኀተሙ 'they will be sealed (up)' (ተኀተመ, tä- stem of ኀተመ 'seal'), with ረሲዓን 'the wicked' (ረሲዕ) as subject, as in Revelation 20:3. The English word order follows the Geʿez, with ምስለ at the start picking up the ending of the last unit.

sentences.i: But those who believed and were baptized in him, in the holy Trinity, and partook of his body and his blood, will be servants to him with all their heart, for no one is able to hate his flesh at all (?); the flesh of Christ cries out within our flesh, and he has mercy for the sake of his body and blood, for they have become his sons and his brothers;
sentences.n: The faithful, set against the Jews. ወእለሰ 'but those who' (-ሰ contrast). ተጠምቁ 'were baptized', ተመጠዉ 'partook' (ተመጠወ 'take communion'), with ሥጋሁ ወደሞ 'his body and his blood' (ደሞ is ደም + -ኦ '3ms his', the accusative form). ዘይክል ጸሊአ 'who is able to hate'; ሥጋሁ 'his flesh', after Ephesians 5:29, 'no one ever hated his own flesh'. ግሙራ 'wholly' is placed between two clauses and could go with either (?): I take it with the first. ይጸርኅ ሥጋ ክርስቶስ በውስተ ሥጋነ 'the flesh of Christ cries out in our flesh': the Eucharistic union. እስመ ኮንዎ ውሉዲ ወአኀዊሁ 'for they became to him sons and brothers': ውሉዲ is ውሉዱ 'his sons' with -ዲ for -ዱ as in chapter 112 (ወልዲ, ዘመዲ); see Hebrews 2:11, 'not ashamed to call them brothers'.

sentences.i: And if there are any who sinned, they will be judged in fire according to the measure of their sins: for him whose burden is light, his judgment is light, and for him whose burden is heavy, his judgment is greater;
sentences.n: A graduated judgment, after Luke 12:47-48 (the servant who knew and the one who did not know are beaten with many or with few stripes: 'to whom much is given, much will be required'). ወእመኒቦ 'and if there be anyone'; ዘአበሱ 'who sinned'; መጠነ አበሳሆሙ 'to the measure of their sins' (መጠነ as a preposition); በእሳት 'in fire'. ጾር 'burden, load' (here the weight of sin) with -ሁ gives ጾሩ. ፈድፈደ 'exceeds, is multiplied'; ክቡድ 'heavy'. The fire is the fire of judgment, graded by the load of sin.

sentences.i: One day with God is as ten thousand years (?). Some are judged for the measure of a day, and some for half a day, and some for three hours of the day, and some for one hour of the day; and some they test and cleanse from their sin.
sentences.n: The measure after 2 Peter 3:8 and Psalm 90:4 (one day with the Lord as a thousand years). The text has ፼ ዓመት, with ፼ the sign for 10,000, not ፲፻ 'a thousand'; I keep it as printed and give 'ten thousand' (?), a probable slip for 1,000 or a deliberate enlargement. ቦዘ is ቦ ዘ run together, 'there is one who', and ወቦዘያሜክርዎ is ወቦ ዘ ያሜክርዎ, 'and there is one whom they test' (አመከረ, imperfect ያሜክር, cf. ዘአመከሮሙ in unit 28): printed without spaces, kept. In ወቦመንፈቀ ዕለት and ወቦ ፫ ሰዐት the verb 'is judged' is understood from the first; ሰዐት and ሰዓት are two spellings in the same unit. ያስተናጽሕዎ 'they cleanse him' (አስተናጽሐ). The 'they' who test and cleanse are not named. The last ፨ ፨ ፨ closes the part.

glossary.ለክሙ: ለ — to you, for you (preposition ለ- with 2mp suffix -ክሙ)
glossary.ለኵሉ: ኵሉ — to all, for everything · all, the whole (ለ- marking the object before a noun: ለኵሉ ዓለም 'the whole world', after ፈጠሮ 'he created it') · ለ- marking the object, 'everyone of' before ዘ- (ያወርዶ ለኵሉ ዘሥጋ 'brings down everyone of the flesh')
glossary.ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
glossary.ለገባሬ: ገባሪ — the doer of (ለ- marking the object + participle, construct)
glossary.ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
glossary.ሊቃነ: ሊቅ — chief, elder (noun; plural construct 'chiefs of')
glossary.ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
glossary.ሐሳዌ: ሐሳዊ — false, lying (adjective; ሐሳዌ መሲሕ 'false Messiah')
glossary.ሐይዉ: ሐይወ — they have come to life, are alive (3mp perfect, G, ḥ-y-w)
glossary.ሕያዋን: ሕያው — living (plural ሕያዋን, adj.) · used as plural noun/predicate: እንዘ ሕያዋን 'while living (ones)'
glossary.ሕጉኒ: ሕግ — his law too (noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
glossary.መምህራነ: መምህር — teachers (noun, plural መምህራን; bound form 'teachers of')
glossary.መርቅያኖስ: መርቅያኖስ — Marcian (proper name; the Roman emperor, if the identification holds) (?)
glossary.መስሕታን: መስሕት — deceivers, misleaders (agent noun, plural መስሕታን, from the root s-ḥ-t, cf. አስሐተ 'lead astray'; apposition)
glossary.መስፈሩ: መስፈርት (?) — its measure (noun + -ሁ '3ms its'; the final ት is missing in the printed form, cf. መሳፍረ ch. 25–26; of the manna) (?)
glossary.መንክር: መንክር — wonder, marvel; wondrous (noun/adj.; here 'of wonder')
glossary.መዛግሒሃ: መዝጋሕ (?) — her bolts, bars (?) (noun, plural መዛግሕ + -ሃ '3fs her'; sense inferred, cf. ዘገሐ 'bolt') (?)
glossary.መግረሬ: መግረሪ (?) — curb, bit, restrainer of (noun, construct; sense inferred from the bridle made of the nails, root uncertain) (?)
glossary.መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
glossary.ማእዜኑ: ማእዜ — when? (interrogative adverb + -ኑ); እስከ ማእዜኑ 'until when, how long'
glossary.ምግባራቲሆሙ: ምግባር — their deeds (noun, plural ምግባራት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; accusative, object of ኀደጉ)
glossary.ሞአ: ሞአ — he overcame, prevailed (3ms perfect, G, m-w-ʾ; in ሞአ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር the case of ቃለ leaves the subject uncertain) (?)
glossary.ሠረጸት: ሠረጸ — it sprouted, came forth (3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ሠራዕነ: ሠርዐ — we ordained, established (1cp perfect, G)
glossary.ሥጋ: ሥጋ — flesh, body (noun; construct 'flesh of') · 'meat' as food (ከመ ይብልዓ ሥጋ 'to eat meat'; ነሥአ ሥጋ 'took meat') · his body, with -ሁ (ሥጋሁ)
glossary.ሥጋሁ: ሥጋ — his body, flesh (+ -u) · 'the body of' before ለ- + a name (ሥጋሁ ለአማኑኤል 'the body of Emmanuel')
glossary.ረሲዓን: ረሲዕ — wicked (adjective, plural ረሲዓን, agreeing with ሰብእ)
glossary.ርእዩ: ርእየ — see! (2mp imperative) · they saw (3mp perfect, ሶበ ርእዩ 'when they saw'; ch. 53)
glossary.ሰማልያል: ሰማልያል (?) — Samalyal (proper name; here the false Messiah, i.e. the Antichrist figure; identification from context) (?)
glossary.ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
glossary.ሰቃልያን: ሰቃሊ — crucifier (agent noun from ሰቀለ 'hang, crucify'; plural ሰቃልያን; the singular is inferred from the plural, Dillmann unavailable)
glossary.ሰዓት: ሰዐት — hour (noun, fem.; the spelling ሰዓት is a variant of ሰዐት)
glossary.ሴሰዮሙ: ሴሰየ — he fed them (3ms perfect, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ቀነውክሙኒ: ቀነወ — you nailed me, pierced me (2mp perfect, G, q-n-w, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ቀፈላ: ቀፈለ (?) — he shut her up, enclosed her (ቀፈለ + -ኣ '3fs her'; cf. ወቀፈላ 'covered, enclosed her', ch. 17–20; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
glossary.ቅስተ: ቅስት (?) — chastisement, scourge (?) (noun, fem., construct 'of'; perhaps for ቅሥት as noted in ch. 97, where the same spelling may be 'bow'; sense from the chapter's content) (?)
glossary.ቅንዋት: ቅንዋት (?) — nails (noun, plural; from ቀነወ 'pierce, nail'; singular not attested to me) (?)
glossary.ቅድሜሁ: ቅድመ — before him (preposition ቅድመ in its form ቅድሜ- + -hu 'him')
glossary.በህየ: ህየ — there, in that place (በ- + adverb)
glossary.በሕሡም: ሕሡም (?) — in corrupt, defiled (?) (በ- + adjective; sense not checked in Dillmann) (?)
glossary.በርትዕት: ርቱዕ — in the right, orthodox (በ- + adjective, fem. ርትዕት)
glossary.በሮሜ: ሮም — in Rome (በ- + proper name; the form ሮሜ is a variant of ሮም)
glossary.በስምዐ: ስምዕ — by the testimony of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በቅድስት: ቅዱስ — to the holy (በ- + feminine ቅድስት of ቅዱስ; agreeing with ታቦት)
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
glossary.በአልባሰ: ልብስ — in garments of (በ- + plural አልባስ, construct 'garments of')
glossary.በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በእዴሁ: እድ — by his hand (በ- 'by' + noun, fem., bound form እዴ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በደመና: ደመና — on a cloud, in a cloud (በ- + noun)
glossary.በጠለ: ጠል — by the dew of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በፈቃዶሙ: ፈቃድ — by their will (በ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በ፫: ፫ — with three (በ- + numeral 3), spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three' (numeral; counted number)
glossary.ባውስተ: ውስተ — within, in (በ- + ውስተ, spelled ባውስተ; apparently a variant or slip for በውስተ) (?)
glossary.ቦዘ: ቦ — some, there are who (existential ቦ 'there is' + relative ዘ; ቦዘ ይትኴነን 'some are judged')
glossary.ተ: ውስተ — final syllable of ውስተ 'into', split off by a stray wordspace (ውስ ፡ ተ); not a separate word
glossary.ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
glossary.ተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — rise! (2mp imperative, Gt) · they arose (3mp perfect) · they set out, departed (ተንሥኡ ለፀብእ 'they set out for war')
glossary.ተዐቅቡ: ተዐቀበ — beware, guard yourselves (2mp imperative, tä-stem of ዐቀበ 'guard')
glossary.ተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — he transgressed, overstepped (3ms perfect, tä-ʿädäwä) · it surpassed (ወእምሰሎሞንኒ ተዐደወ ጥበብኪ 'your wisdom surpassed even Solomon')
glossary.ታበርህ: አብርሀ — she shines (3fs imperfect, causative of በርሀ 'be bright'; subject Zion) · also of wisdom and of a lamp (ጥበብ ወአእምሮ ታበርህ 'wisdom and knowledge shine'; ማኅቶተ እንተ ታበርህ ሊተ 'a lamp that shines for me')
glossary.ታበጽሕ: አብጽሐ — she will make reach, hold out (3fs imperfect, causative of በጽሐ 'arrive'; ታበጽሕ እደዊሃ 'she will make her hands reach'; Psalm 68:31)
glossary.ትሄሉ: ሀሎ — she exists, is (3fs imperfect, h-l-w)
glossary.ትትሀየድ: ተሀየደ (?) — it/she will be taken away, removed (3fs imperfect, tä-stem passive of ሀየደ 'remove'; subject the bridle) (?)
glossary.ትነብር: ነበረ — she dwells, sits (3fs imperfect, n-b-r)
glossary.ትንቢተ: ትንቢት — prophecy of (noun, fem., construct state)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
glossary.ኀቤክሙ: ኀበ — to you (preposition, stem ኀቤ- + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ኀይል: ኀይል — strength, might (noun; construct ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength', i.e. the mighty)
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us') · accusative object 'a king' (ወለደት ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'she bore a heavenly king')
glossary.ንግረነ: ነገረ — tell us (2ms imperative, G, n-g-r, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አመኬ: አመ — when (conjunction አመ + emphatic enclitic -ኬ); or እመ 'if' (እመኬ) (?)
glossary.አሚረ: አሚር — day (noun, accusative; ኵሎ አሚረ 'all day')
glossary.አማዑቲሆሙ: አማዕዋት (?) — their bowels, entrails (plural noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their', form አማዑቲ-; the singular is not known to me; cf. አማዕዋቲሁ ch. 49–50) (?)
glossary.አርአየኒ: አርአየ — he showed me (3ms perfect, causative of ርእየ 'see', + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አሮንመ: አሮን — Aaron indeed (proper name + enclitic -መ, emphatic like -ሰ) (?)
glossary.አስማዕናክሙ: አስምዐ — we made you hear (1cp perfect, causative of ሰምዐ, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.አትከሉ: ተከለ (?) — they set up, fixed (3mp perfect; the initial አ- as printed, a causative or a slip for ተከሉ; cf. ተከለ 'plant, fix') (?)
glossary.አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
glossary.አዕለውዋ: አዕለወ — they perverted her (3mp perfect, causative of ዐለወ 'transgress' + -ዋ '3fs her'; the faith)
glossary.ኢየዐልዉ: ዐለወ — they will not pervert, transgress (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ʿ-l-w)
glossary.ኢይበቊዕ: በቊዐ — it is of no use, does not avail (ኢ- negation + 3ms imperfect ይበቊዕ, G)
glossary.እሌኒ: እሌኒ — Helena (proper name; the mother of Constantine)
glossary.እምቃለ: ቃል — from the voice, word of (እም- + noun, construct) · 'than the voice of, more than' in comparison (ወአፍቀሩ ቃለ መሰንቆ እምቃለ መዝሙር 'they loved the voice of the lyre more than the voice of the psalm')
glossary.እምቅድሜነ: ቅድሜ — from before us (እም- + ቅድሜ- 'before' + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel') · 'above' in ተሰብሐ እምነ ኵሎሙ 'was praised above (?) all of them', or possibly the agent 'by' (?) · partitive 'of, from among' (እምነ ፸ አርድእት 'of the seventy disciples')
glossary.እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እነግረክሙ: ነገረ — I will tell you (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, n-g-r, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ) · 'from' (?) before ቀላየ ባሕር, standing for a preposition because the relative 'which' fits poorly (እንተ ቀላየ ባሕር 'from the depths of the sea', Psalm 68:22) (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')

glossary.እደዊሃ: እድ — her hands (plural እደው, construct-form እደዊ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')

glossary.ወሪድየ: ረድአ (?) — and my help (?) (ወ- + an uncertain form; perhaps a noun 'my help' with -የ '1cs my' from ረድአ 'help', or 'and I helped'; the unit renders 'my help') (?)

glossary.ወቅንዋትሰ: ቅንዋት (?) — and as for the nails (ወ- + plural noun + -ሰ 'as for'; see ቅንዋት) (?)

glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')

glossary.ወአኀዊሁ: እኁ — and his brothers (ወ- + plural አኀው, አኀዊ- + -ሁ '3ms his')

glossary.ወኤልያስ: ኤልያስ — Elijah, Elias (proper name; here a personal name, son of Arni; ወ- 'and')

glossary.ወይገፈትእዋ: ገፍትአ — and they will thrust her aside, repel her (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ወይፈትሑ: ፈትሐ — and they will open (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, f-t-ḥ)
glossary.ወደሞ: ደም — and his blood (ወ- + noun, accusative + -ኦ 'his')
glossary.ወገሞራ: ገሞራ — and Gomorrah (ወ- + proper name, place)
glossary.ወ፫: ፫ — and 3, spoken ወሠለስ (wä-śäläs) (?) 'and three' before the feminine ሌሊት (numeral, ወ- + digit) · in ፪ ወ፫ 'two or three' (ch. 114) ወ means 'or', spoken ወሠለስቱ (wä-śälästu)
glossary.ውሉዲ: ወልድ — his sons (noun, plural ውሉድ + -ሁ '3ms his', spelled -ዲ for -ዱ as ወልዲ, ዘመዲ in ch. 112) (?)
glossary.ውሕኮ: ውሕክ (?) — fewness, weakening (?) (noun, or a form of a verb 'be few'; the ending -ኮ unexplained; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ውስ: ውስተ — in, into (first part of ውስተ, split by a stray wordspace ውስ ፡ ተ ፡ ግዕዞሙ; not a separate word)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውስጦሙሰ: ውስጥ — within them, as for within (noun/preposition 'inside' + -ሆሙ '3mp', written -ዶሙ; ወእንተ ውስጦሙሰ 'while inside them')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዐብዩ: ዐበየ — they are great, became great (3mp perfect, G, ʿ-b-y)
glossary.ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
glossary.ዕልወ: ዕልው — perverter, perverse one (adjective/noun, construct; house ዕልው 'perverse, crooked', ch. 108, from ዐለወ); ዕልወ ሃይማኖት 'perverter of the faith' or 'perverse in faith' (?)
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity') · 'for ever' as an adverb after a noun (ደዌ ዘለዓለም 'sickness for ever')
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘብሉይ: ብሉይ — of the old, old (ዘ- 'of' + adjective)
glossary.ዘቦቱ: በ — who has (ዘ- relative + preposition በ + -ቱ '3ms'; ቦቱ 'in him', expressing possession: 'he who has')
glossary.ዘትጸንን: ጸንዐ (?) — which she holds fast to (?) (ዘ- relative + 3fs imperfect; the ending -ን for -ዕ is irregular, cf. ትጽናዕ ch. 70; 'be firm') (?)
glossary.ዘንተኬ: ዝንቱ — this indeed (accusative ዘንተ + emphatic enclitic -ኬ)
glossary.ዘአመከሮሙ: አመከረ — who tempted them (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of መከረ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ዘአበሱ: አበሰ — who sinned (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G, ʾ-b-s)
glossary.ዘኢየዐቅብ: ዐቀበ — who does not keep (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘእምኀቤከ: ኀበ — that which is from you (ዘ- relative + እም- 'from' + ኀቤ- + -ከ '2ms')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame') · 'except' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ሐሰት 'except falsehood')
glossary.ዘከሠተ: ከሠተ — what he revealed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘወረደት: ወረደ — who came down (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G, w-r-d)
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘዐለዉ: ዐለወ — what they transgressed (ዘ- + 3mp perfect, ʿ-l-w 'transgress'; here 'because they transgressed', በእንተ ዘ-) · 'all that they perverted' (ኵሉ ዘዐለዉ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'all that they perverted of the word of God', ch. 114; ዐለወ 'be perverse, pervert', cf. ዕልው ch. 108)
glossary.ዘዕለት: ዕለት — of the day (ዘ- 'of' + noun, fem.)
glossary.ዘየዐቅባ: ዐቀበ — who guards her, it (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, ʿ-q-b, + -ኣ '3fs'; the throne)
glossary.ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘይሰቅያ: ሰቀየ — which waters her (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, + -ኣ '3fs her'; the earth)
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘይነብር: ነበረ — dwell, sit, remain (3ms imperfect; ዘ- 'who')
glossary.ዘይክል: ከሀለ — who is able (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ዘገበርኩ: ገብረ — which I did (ዘ- relative + 1cs perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘገብረት: ገብረ — which she made (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘገብሩ: ገብረ — which they made (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘጸሐፈ: ጸሐፈ — which he wrote (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-ḥ-f)
glossary.የሀይዳ: ሀየደ — he will remove it (3ms imperfect, G, h-y-d, + -ኣ '3fs it'; the curb)
glossary.ይመስለኒ: መሰለ — it seems to me (3ms imperfect, G, + -ኒ '1cs to me')
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይቁም: ቆመ — let him stand (3ms jussive, G, q-w-m)
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይብልዎሙ: ብህለ — they say to them (3mp imperfect, G, defective b-h-l, + -ልዎሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ይትሀወክ: ተሀወከ — it is shaken (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ሀወከ)
glossary.ይትኀበልኑ: ተኀበለ (?) — will it be harmed, damaged? (?) (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive + interrogative -ኑ; root ḫ-b-l uncertain) (?)
glossary.ይትኀተሙ: ተኀትመ — they will be sealed up (3mp imperfect, tä-stem passive of ኀተመ 'seal')
glossary.ይትነሥኡ: ተንሥአ — they will rise (3mp imperfect, Gt)
glossary.ይትኤዝዝ: ተአዘዘ — he will be commanded, receive orders; or he will obey (as ተአዘዘ ch. 112) (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of አዘዘ 'command') (?)
glossary.ይትኴነኑ: ተኰነነ — they will be judged (3mp imperfect, tä-stem passive of ኰነነ)
glossary.ይትኴነን: ተኰነነ — he is judged, condemned (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ኰነነ)
glossary.ይትዐረቅ: ተዐረቀ (?) — it is poured out (?) (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive; root ʿ-r-q uncertain, sense guessed) (?)
glossary.ይትዐደዋ: ተዐደወ — he will transgress it (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, + -ዋ '3fs it, her'; the faith)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
glossary.ይከውኑ: ኮነ — they will be (3mp imperfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ይጸርኅ: ጸርሐ — he cries out (3ms imperfect, ṣ-r-ḥ)
glossary.ይፀብእዎ: ፀብአ — they will fight him (3mp imperfect, G, ṣ-b-ʾ, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ዲቤሃ: ዲበ — upon her, upon it (preposition ዲበ, stem ዲቤ- + -ሃ '3fs'; the throne)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ዳግመ: ዳግም — again, a second time (adverb, accusative form in -a)
glossary.ድሉተ: ድሉት — prepared, ready (adjective, fem./accusative predicate; ኢኮነት ድሉተ 'was not made ready')
glossary.ግሙራ: ግሙር — whole, complete; ግሙራ adverbial, 'wholly, altogether' (adv.); the same form stands as an adverb elsewhere in the text; see crux
glossary.ግብአታ: ግብአት — return (noun, fem.; with -ኣ '3fs her' anticipating ለጽዮን 'her return, that of Zion')
glossary.ግዕዞሙ: ግዕዝ — their freedom (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'); ውስተ ግዕዞሙ 'into their own freedom' (?)
glossary.ጎሞር: ጎሞር — gomor, omer (Hebrew loan; a measure, here the golden urn of manna)
glossary.ጠየቅነ: ጠየቀ — we asked, inquired (1cp perfect, G, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ጳጳሳቲሆሙ: ጳጳስ — their bishops (noun, plural ጳጳሳት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'); ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቲሆሙ 'the chief bishops of their bishops'
glossary.ጳጵሳት: ጳጳስ — bishops (noun, plural ጳጳሳት; spelled with ጵ, a printed slip)
glossary.ጴጥሮስኒ: ጴጥሮስ — Peter too (proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also'; in መንበረ ጴጥሮስኒ 'the throne of Peter too')
glossary.ጸሊአ: ጸልአ — to hate (verbal noun / infinitive, accusative, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy') · nominative, collective 'an enemy' (ወይበልዕ ፀር እለ ኢታአምር 'an enemy you do not know will eat')
glossary.ፈድፈደ: ፈድፈደ — he exceeds, surpasses (3ms perfect, quadriliteral, f-d-f-d)
glossary.ፋርስ: ፋርስ — Persia (proper name, land; dependent on the construct ንጉሠ 'king of Persia'; also subject, fem.)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
glossary.፪: ፪ — 2, spoken ክልኤቱ (kəlʾetu) 'two'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'two' (ዘእንበለ ፪ በትር 'except two rods')
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
glossary.፻፲፫: ፻፲፫ — spoken ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወሠለስቱ (məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-śälästu) 'one hundred and thirteen'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፻፲፬: ፻፲፬ — spoken ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወአርባዕቱ (məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-ʾarbaʿtu) 'one hundred and fourteen'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፻፲፭: ፻፲፭ — spoken ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወኀምስቱ (məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-ḫaməstu) 'one hundred and fifteen'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፼: ፼ — 10,000, spoken ዐሠርቱ አእላፍ (ʿäśärtu ʾäʾəlaf) 'ten thousand' (?) (numeral, Ethiopic digit ፼; the exact spoken word is uncertain, ትእልፊት being another word for a myriad (?))
